good_thing: (Middletown, Rhode Island): The Potter League for Animals has welcomed four dogs rescued from the streets of Kabul: Linus, Tope, Diesel, and Zeus. After Rhode Island’s required five-day isolation and veterinary preparation, the dogs are expected to become available for adoption.
current_or_history: On November 26, 1864, Charles Lutwidge Dodgson, writing as Lewis Carroll, sent Alice Liddell his handwritten, illustrated manuscript of “Alice’s Adventures Under Ground.” It began with a story told to Alice and her sisters on a July 1862 river outing, then grew into “Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland.”
tiny_fact: An octopus has three hearts: two pump blood to its gills for oxygen, while the third circulates oxygenated blood through the rest of its body.
thought: You do not have to make the whole day meaningful for one small part of it to be enough.
